<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>7-Day CPU Temperature Chart</title>
    <style>
        body {
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            margin: 0;
            background-color: #f0f0f0;
        }
        .chart-container {
            width: 800px;
            height: 500px;
            background-color: white;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            padding: 20px;
            position: relative;
        }
        canvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .axis-label {
            position: absolute;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #333;
        }
        .y-axis-label {
            left: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: rotate(-90deg) translateX(-50%);
            transform-origin: left;
        }
        .x-axis-label {
            bottom: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }
        .title {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: #333;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="chart-container">
        <div class="title">7-Day CPU Temperature (°C)</div>
        <div class="axis-label y-axis-label">Temperature (°C)</div>
        <div class="axis-label x-axis-label">Day</div>
        <canvas id="tempChart"></canvas>
    </div>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('tempChart');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // Set canvas resolution to match display size
        const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
        canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth * dpr;
        canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight * dpr;
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

        // Sample data: 7 days of CPU temperatures (40-85°C)
        const days = ['Day 1', 'Day 2', 'Day 3', 'Day 4', 'Day 5', 'Day 6', 'Day 7'];
        const temperatures = [
            55, 62, 48, 72, 68, 80, 59
        ];

        // Chart dimensions
        const padding = 50;
        const chartWidth = canvas.offsetWidth - 2 * padding;
        const chartHeight = canvas.offsetHeight - 2 * padding;

        // Draw grid and axes
        function drawAxes() {
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ddd';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;

            // Y-axis grid lines
            const yStep = 10;
            for (let y = 40; y <= 85; y += yStep) {
                const yPos = canvas.offsetHeight - padding - ((y - 40) / (85 - 40)) * chartHeight;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(padding, yPos);
                ctx.lineTo(canvas.offsetWidth - padding, yPos);
                ctx.stroke();

                // Y-axis labels
                ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
                ctx.font = '12px Arial';
                ctx.textAlign = 'right';
                ctx.fillText(y, padding - 10, yPos + 4);
            }

            // X-axis labels
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            for (let i = 0; i < days.length; i++) {
                const xPos = padding + (i / (days.length - 1)) * chartWidth;
                ctx.fillText(days[i], xPos, canvas.offsetHeight - padding + 20);
            }
        }

        // Draw temperature line
        function drawTemperatureLine() {
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#e74c3c';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.beginPath();

            for (let i = 0; i < temperatures.length; i++) {
                const x = padding + (i / (temperatures.length - 1)) * chartWidth;
                const y = canvas.offsetHeight - padding - ((temperatures[i] - 40) / (85 - 40)) * chartHeight;

                if (i === 0) {
                    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
                } else {
                    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
                }

                // Draw data point
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x, y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
                ctx.fill();
            }

            ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Draw chart
        drawAxes();
        drawTemperatureLine();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
